description: Without signing in: the last price for any supported name, delayed 15 minutes (the last 1-minute bar that closed by then, or the last close outside the session). Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: the same. With a QuantGeeks plan: live. The last price for a supported name (see quantgeeks_list_symbols: SPX, SPY, QQQ, VIX and the rest), from QuantGeeks' own bars: the newest 1-minute bar close while the session is open, and the latest daily close when it is shut, with the basis and as-of time stated. Any other symbol is refused with the list of supported names. Without a plan the same answer is delayed.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to its 0DTE option root SPXW), SPY, QQQ, VIX.

name: quantgeeks_get_last_price
title: Last price
